links.outcome: Readability and understandability of LLM answers to rotator cuff tear questions
links.effect: Median PEMAT Understandability 83.33 (77.3% sufficient); median Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease 42.05 (88.9% sufficient); only 39.8% of answers sufficient in both quality and readability.
links.quote: The median PEMAT Understandability score was 83.33, with 77.3% sufficiency, while the Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease score had a median of 42.05 with 88.9% sufficiency.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, accuracy, and readability of four popular LLMs (ChatGPT 3.5, ChatGPT 4, Gemini, Microsoft CoPilot) on frequently asked questions about rotator cuff tears without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
